statement.exactness_scope: boxes with integer log2 endpoints (multiplicative powers of 2); general rational boxes need logs
statement.f: f(d,h) = max_j (d_j - (D h)_j) + indicator(h in box [L,U]), h = log2 y in R^4, D = [[1,-2,1,0],[0,1,-2,1]]
statement.fiber_y: h in the box (4 variables); x = d in R^2
statement.g: g(d) = inf_h f(d,h) = min over the box of max_j (d_j - (Dh)_j)
statement.ledger_reduced_object: max over the 4 rays r of (r.d - sigma(r)) / (r0 + r1); feasibility is g(0) <= 0, i.e. all sigma(r) >= 0
